definitions.gloss: sharing gifts or food received, passing along a portion
definitions.explanation: The practice of sharing part of something you have received (food, gifts, good fortune) with others. Reflects the Japanese custom of distributing gifts and surplus among neighbors, friends, and colleagues.

examples.japanese: お{裾分|すそわ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I received a share (of something they got).

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{裾分|すそわ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received some apples as a share from my neighbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{裾分|すそわ}け⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A lot of vegetables arrived from my parents' home in the countryside, so I shared some with my coworkers.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (お{裾分|すそわ}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to share with others) or ⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧/⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (to receive a share). The お prefix is standard and rarely omitted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{裾分|すそわ}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to share with others
- お{裾分|すそわ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to receive a share
- お{裾分|すそわ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧: to receive a share (polite)
- {幸|しあわ}せ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{裾分|すそわ}け: sharing one's happiness (figurative)

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧ (hem of a garment) + {分|わ}け (dividing/sharing). The image is of sharing from the edges or surplus of what one has.

CULTURAL NOTE:
This practice is deeply embedded in Japanese community life. When someone receives a large quantity of food, seasonal produce from relatives, or souvenirs from a trip, sharing portions with neighbors and colleagues is expected.
